task_description: Complete rewrite of the frontend to display checklist data in TABLE/GRID format matching the actual paper forms from Merling Care Limited - Glebe House Care Home. Must show previous data (past weeks with staff initials), current week highlighted and editable, per-room navigation, pink/magenta branding, and production-quality design that replaces the paper binder.

verification.summary: All backend source files pass syntax check. Semantic review issues addressed: (1) sign-off cells only interactive for TODAY, (2) IPC tab filters by ipc_critical flag, (3) debounce guard on signOffTask, (4) race condition guard on loadChecklist. Port 3000 not accessible between processes in this sandbox so integration tests cannot run but syntax checks all pass.
